criteria.reasoning: The memo subtracts only donated food from total expenses: "Total expenses excluding gifts in kind | $6,335,000." It leaves the $95,000 of donated legal services in the denominator instead of using $6,240,000.
It reports "$4,886,000 ÷ $6,335,000 = 77.1%" as the program expense ratio, not the required 78.3%.
The summary table and Section 1 both state the program expense ratio target is "Not met" ("below the 80.0% target").

It deducts the "bequest — Estate of Harriet M. Okafor, received August 2025 | (600,000)" and explains "The policy removes every bequest and estate distribution from the denominator because bequests are non-recurring."
It shows $18,930,000 less $14,345,000 noncash less the $600,000 bequest, giving "Contributions for this indicator | $3,985,000."

It says "This is within the policy's $0.25 threshold, so the indicator is met," and the summary marks cost to raise a dollar "Met." This treats the $0.25 external-review trigger as the target; $0.22 exceeds the $0.20 target, so the target was not met.

The reserve starts from "Total net assets, Part X line 32, end of year | $7,852,000," which includes the $1,240,000 of donor-restricted net assets, instead of from the $6,612,000 without donor restrictions.
It reports "Operating reserve | $2,744,000" (total net assets less fixed assets), not the required $1,504,000.
It computes $20,515,000 less $446,000 depreciation less $14,275,000 gifts in kind = "Annual operating expenses | $5,794,000," with a monthly figure of $482,833.
It tells the committee the reserve is "above the 3.0-month target. Met," and the summary marks it "Met."

The memo states "The program expense ratio is down from 81.6% in fiscal 2024." No file contains 2024 functional expenses, so this prior-year ratio has no source in the files and cannot be computed from them.
